title: [Bug] Getting AttributeError: module 'dspy' has no attribute 'AzureOpenAI'
author: GreenhouseCoffee

comments.author: GreenhouseCoffee
comments.body: Any debugging help, implementation guidance, similar experiences and workarounds would be appreciated!

comments.author: TomeHirata
comments.body: We don't have dspy.AzureOpenAI now. We use litellm for communicating with LLMs, so please take a look at https://docs.litellm.ai/docs/providers/azure/ for how to configure AzureOpenAI with LiteLLM and pass the correct model (`azure/<your_deployment_name>`) to dspy.LM and set the environment variables. Thank you!

comments.author: GreenhouseCoffee
comments.body: Oh wow - I've been out of the loop for a bit and a lot has changed! Thanks for the link!
